subject: NO HOT WATER

subject: need help before Thanksgiving
body:
Hi,

We have 14 people coming for Thanksgiving and our kitchen sink is completely blocked, nothing drains at all. We need this fixed before Wednesday. Is there any way you can fit us in?

Thank you so much,
Dorothea

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us

notes: 'Before Wednesday' is relative so no date. The draft must not promise to fit them in.

subject: water heater leaking
body: our water heater is leaking slowly from the bottom. i put a bucket under it and empty it every few hours so its contained for now. how fast can someone come?

evidence.anchor: a slow leak that is contained

notes: A contained slow leak is urgent, not an emergency, per the documents. If it could not be contained it would become one.

subject: toilet repair by Friday
body:
Hello, our toilet is cracked and leaking at the base. My landlord says it has to be repaired by Friday Nov 6 or we get fined. It's the apartment on the 3rd floor. Please advise ASAP.

Tabitha Greaves

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us

notes: Date and property type present, neighbourhood missing, so details are requested.

subject: basement drain smell
body: the floor drain in my basement is gurgling and there's a really bad smell coming up, kinda like sewer. nothing coming up out of it yet. can someone look today?

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us

notes: Deliberately borderline: a sewer smell and gurgling, but explicitly 'nothing coming up'. Labelled urgent-not-emergency. If sewage began backing up it would escalate.
